# 10 Cent Agency

> 10 Cent Agency is a Bangladesh-based, registered full-service digital marketing agency for small and medium businesses. We run Facebook & Meta ads, Google Ads, website development, AI chatbots & automation, social media management, SEO/AEO/GEO, and graphic design — one accountable team, transparent reporting, and no markup on ad spend. Tagline: Professional | Affordable | Unstoppable.

## Company Information

- **Legal name:** 10 Cent Agency (registered business entity in Bangladesh)
- **Founded:** 2026
- **Founder:** Md Al Amin
- **Location:** East Monipur, Mirpur, Dhaka 1216, Bangladesh
- **Website:** https://www.10centagency.com
- **Email:** hello@10centagency.com

- **X (Twitter):** https://x.com/10centagency
- **Business hours:** Saturday–Thursday, 10AM–9PM (BST)
- **Languages:** Bangla and English (all services; Banglish supported in ads & chatbots)
- **Payments accepted:** bKash, Nagad, Rocket, and all major cards via SSLCommerz

## Services (7)

### Core Service 01 — Facebook & Meta Marketing
Data-driven Facebook & Instagram marketing with server-side (Conversions API) tracking, so every taka spent is measurable.
- Page setup, content creation, and ad management
- Pixel + Conversions API (server-side) tracking
- Advantage+ campaigns and creative testing
- Zero markup on ad spend — the client owns the ad account
- Monthly plain-language performance reports
More info: [Facebook & Meta Marketing](https://www.10centagency.com/services/facebook-meta-marketing)

### Core Service 02 — Google Ads
Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Display, YouTube & Performance Max) management for Bangladeshi businesses.
- Keyword & intent research (Bangla + English), tight campaign structure
- Negative keyword management and waste reduction
- Conversion tracking setup (Google Ads + GA4 + Tag Manager)
- Remarketing, Shopping & Performance Max campaigns
- Fixed monthly management fee — never a percentage of ad spend; client pays Google directly and owns the account
More info: [Google Ads](https://www.10centagency.com/services/google-ads)

### Core Service 03 — Website Development
Fast, mobile-first websites and e-commerce stores built on WordPress + Elementor or Next.js/React.
- Business sites, landing pages, and e-commerce stores
- bKash, Nagad, Rocket & card payments via SSLCommerz
- Mobile-first build, <3s load target, 95+ PageSpeed target
- Pixel + CAPI + GA4 + UTM tracking built in
- Domain, hosting, SSL & on-page SEO included; 1 month free post-launch support
More info: [Website Development](https://www.10centagency.com/services/website-development)

### Core Service 04 — AI Automation & Chatbot
AI-powered chatbots on Messenger, WhatsApp & Telegram that answer questions, capture leads, and process orders 24/7.
- Bangla, English & Banglish conversations with human handover
- Facebook comment → DM lead capture
- n8n workflows: invoices, reminders, order confirmations
- Unified inbox + CRM / Google Sheets sync
- 3-day free trial — zero commitment
More info: [AI Automation & Chatbot](https://www.10centagency.com/services/ai-automation-chatbot)

### Core Service 05 — Social Media Management
Complete monthly management of Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube & Google Business Profile.
- Platform-specific content calendar, post design (Bangla + English)
- Reels/Shorts editing, stories, highlight icons
- AI-powered comment & inbox management
- Monthly performance report with next-month recommendations
More info: [Social Media Management](https://www.10centagency.com/services/social-media-management)

### Core Service 06 — SEO, AEO & GEO
One visibility system covering Google rankings (SEO), featured snippets & answer engines (AEO), and AI-chatbot citations (GEO).
- On-page SEO, technical SEO (sitemap, robots, Core Web Vitals), local SEO / Google Business Profile
- FAQ schema, People-Also-Ask & snippet targeting
- Entity building, structured data, and llms.txt setup so ChatGPT, Gemini & Perplexity can cite the brand
- AI visibility tracking in monthly reports
More info: [SEO, AEO & GEO](https://www.10centagency.com/services/seo-aeo-geo)

### Add-On Service 07 — Graphic Design
Brand identity and marketing design with full commercial ownership.
- Brand identity: logo (primary, icon, monochrome), color palette, typography, brand style guide
- Social media graphics, templates, banners, stories
- Print-ready marketing materials & packaging (CMYK, bleed-safe, die-lines)
- Pitch deck & presentation design
- Delivery in AI/EPS/PDF/PNG/JPG/SVG — 100% ownership, print & digital ready
More info: [Graphic Design](https://www.10centagency.com/services/graphic-design)

## How We Work (same 5 steps on every service)

1. **Discovery Call** — free consultation on goals, budget & audience
2. **Strategy & Proposal** — custom plan and transparent itemized quote
3. **Build / Setup** — design, development, campaign setup, or content production
4. **Launch & Optimize** — go live with real-time monitoring and quick iteration
5. **Report & Scale** — plain-language monthly reports; scale what works

## Working Policies (as published on the website)

- Custom-scoped pricing only — no one-size-fits-all packages; quotes after a free consultation
- Contact-form budget bands: BDT 5,000–10,000 / 10,000–20,000 / 20,000–40,000 / 40,000+
- Zero markup on Meta & Google ad spend; clients pay platforms directly and keep 100% ownership of accounts, pixels, and data
- Month-to-month retainers — no 6/12-month lock-in; cancel at the end of any cycle
- 48-hour turnaround on design/content revisions
- Dedicated account manager for every client
- Free consultation: https://calendly.com/10centagency/free-consultation

- Enterprise-level strategy at small-business prices
